messages:
Ivy (marketing): Quick sync — aiming to announce release 1.5 next Thurs. Need pinned changelog URL, docs examples, three short bench bullets, and a webinar demo owner by EOD Tue. Who volunteers for demo? @Rina?
Rina (eng): I can do demo. Will show the canary toggle + realtime latency panel. Need stable changelog link and a sample request showing X-Prefix-Cache header.
Owen (eng): Changelog draft is at https://redwood.internal/changelogs/1.5-draft. Added notes on default_batch and cache-ttl.
Tara (docs): I'll add curl/python snippets, plus a short migration note. ETA Wed morning.
Marc (marketing): For marketing copy: three bullets — p50 delta, token-cost, throughput. Victor pls confirm safe numbers for the public blurb.
Victor (product): Conservative numbers: p50 ~42% lower, p95 ~27% lower on 2k seq; unit cost ~17% lower with cache + batching. I'll DM the spreadsheet cells.
Ivy (marketing): Webinar time preference: 9am PT release morning. Rina demo, Victor product narrative, Ivy moderate. Need slides and CSV for charts.
Rina (eng): Bench CSVs are in s3://bench/release-1725/summary.csv. Will paste the raw CSV link to the slides channel.
Marc (marketing): Inbound CTA: 'Request a demo' should post utm_campaign=rls-1725 and model_hint fields. Who owns the sales webhook?
Victor (product): Sales webhook: https://hooks.redwood.com/leads. Include utm_campaign=rls-1725, lead_source=web, model_hint=redwood-lite. Sales confirmed AE routing for enterprise signals.
Owen (eng): I'll run a webhook smoke test from staging and post the curl here after.
preflight-bot: Preflight queued — tasks: docs_publish, changelog_pin, cdn_invalidate, webhook_smoke_test, webinar_slides. Will report status updates.
Tara (docs): Legal approved privacy line: "Private deployments retain data in the customer's VPC." I'll add it to the post and changelog.
Ivy (marketing): Final owners: slides (Marc), demo script (Rina), docs publish (Tara), changelog pin (Owen), webhook test (Owen), bench confirm (Rina). Dry run Sat 08:30 PT. If anything blocks, reply here and tag me.
